title: Network scan & mapping
tips: Baseline every map from local IP + mask + default gateway before scanning peers.
Sparse ARP often means quiet hosts or ICMP filter — directed pings fill the table.
Separate host-down (no ARP) from port-filtered (host up, service closed) in your notes.
mDNS and AirPrint break across VLANs and with AP client isolation — map L2 first.
For Wi-Fi failures capture SSID, BSSID, channel, and RSSI at the problem desk.
Duplicate IP shows as flapping MAC in ARP or conflicting gratuitous ARP replies.
